sections.heading: C2 — Confusables and KG hints
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Right-of-Way

FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A01
Right-of-way is given rather than seized, and failure-to-yield fines double from bodily injury to serious bodily injury bands [A01].
Why it matters: group yield-basics; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A01
Narrow roads yield to divided or three-plus-lane roads, while unpaved roads yield to paved ones [A01].
Why it matters: group intersection-yield; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A01
A left-turning driver yields to vehicles traveling straight from the opposite direction. At a T-intersection, traffic on the ending street stops and yields to vehicles on the through street. Leaving a private road, alley, building or driveway requires stopping before the sidewalk and yielding to all approaching vehicles and pedestrians [A01].
Why it matters: group intersection-yield; difficulty medium; prereq sec04-F02; confusables sec04-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A02
Rail stops land fifteen to fifty feet from the rails, triggered by warnings or trains within about one thousand five hundred feet [A02].
Why it matters: group rail-crossings; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F04 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A03
Flashing red means hold until train and lights finish, lowered gates mean hold until train and gates finish, and stalled drivers flee trackside toward the train [A03].
Why it matters: group rail-crossings; difficulty high; prereq sec04-F04; confusables sec04-F05 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A04
Yield to an emergency vehicle's warning signal: stop at the right edge if traffic allows, or slow and clear its path. Keep five hundred feet behind a fire truck answering an alarm or an ambulance flashing red lights. Unless an officer directs otherwise, a stopped emergency vehicle displaying lights requires leaving the adjacent lane on a road with at least two same-direction lanes, or slowing twenty miles per hour below a limit of twenty-five or higher, or below five miles per hour when the limit is lower [A04][A03].
Why it matters: group emergency-yield; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec04-F07, sec04-F08 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec04-R07 | anchor: A04
Buses with flashing red stop both directions to motion, wave-through, or dark lights, except across separate roads or protected loading zones, with fines and jail climbing per repeat and injury [A04].
Why it matters: group school-bus; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec04-F09 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec04-R08 | anchor: A04
Walkers win uncontrolled crossings, WALK phases, green lights, and mid-crossing changes alike, reminded by Yield Here, in-street, and overhead signs [A04].
Why it matters: group pedestrian-yield; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec04-F10 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec04-R09 | anchor: A05
Hybrid beacons stop drivers on alternating flashing red before a clear-go, while in-roadway lights simply warn of hidden hazards ahead [A05].
Why it matters: group pedestrian-devices; difficulty medium; prereq sec04-F10; confusables sec04-F11, sec04-F12 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0030]
